name: Germany
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national level in every layer (Bundestag, parties, alliances, unions, economists, commentators, wealthy supporters), the 16 Länder as a register, and one sampled Landtag (Berlin). First pass R001 (2026-10-20): Bundestag motions and bills 2010-2026 with their named sponsors (harvest H0001-H0008), party programmes, the alliance 'Vermögen besteuern jetzt' (22 signatories plus 12 joiners), union and NGO statements, DIW and taz commentary, taxmenow and earlier millionaires' appeals. Not done: BSW (bsw-vg.de refuses connections from this environment), SPD/Greens/Left individuals beyond sponsors, European Parliament, other Landtage and Länder governments, media outlets other than taz, Zeit and Freitag, faith bodies, culture, municipalities (the Länder register is the lowest level loaded). The Left's own site (die-linke.de) answers 403 even to a browser, so its programme was read from an easy-read edition.

polls.question: Reintroducing the wealth tax: a levy on private persons and companies on wealth above EUR 1 million
